description: This file contains bash script functions for managing and normalizing Docker authentication directories and files for the OpenClaw project. It provides utilities to process provider-specific authentication directories and files, handle overrides, and concatenate CSV values.

methods.name: openclaw_live_trim
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: openclaw_live_normalize_auth_dir
methods.description: Normalizes a directory path by trimming and ensuring it starts with a dot.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_dir_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth directory for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_should_include_auth_file_for_provider
methods.description: Returns the auth file for a given provider.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_csv
methods.description: Collects unique auth directories from a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth directories based on override environment variable or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_dirs
methods.description: Collects auth directories considering overrides or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_csv
methods.description: Collects unique auth files from a CSV list of providers.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files_from_override
methods.description: Collects auth files based on override environment variable or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_collect_auth_files
methods.description: Collects auth files considering overrides or defaults.

methods.name: openclaw_live_join_csv
methods.description: Joins multiple values into a CSV string.
